tools.name: solana_token_verdict
tools.description: Use when your agent is about to buy or swap into an unknown Solana token: go/no-go rug check read from chain state. Returns SAFE/CAUTION/DANGER, 0-100 risk score and flags. Skip DANGER, reduce size on CAUTION. Costs 0.001 USDC (x402, Solana or Base).

tools.name: solana_token_check
tools.description: Use before any Jupiter or pump.fun trade on an unknown Solana mint: full rug check from chain state. Verdict, risk score, flags (freeze or mint authority, Token-2022 traps, wallet concentration, age, pump.fun creator dumping or serial launches), authorities, holders, creator. Costs 0.005 USDC (x402,

tools.name: solana_token_batch
tools.description: Use when screening up to 10 new Solana tokens at once (sniping, watchlists): same output as the full check for each mint, half the per-token price. Costs 0.025 USDC (x402, Solana or Base).

tools.name: tokenguard_info
tools.description: Free: what TokenGuard checks, prices and how to pay (x402).
